Class JsonNumber

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonNumber
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonValue
public final class JsonNumber extends Object implements JsonValue

A JSON number, kept exactly as written: it is converted only when one of the as methods is called.

The exact conversions, asInt(), asLong(), asShort(), asByte() and asBigInteger(), accept any number whose value is an integer in their range, such as 1.0 or 1e2, and throw an ArithmeticException otherwise. asDouble() and asFloat() return the nearest value. asBigDecimal() is always exact.

Two numbers are equal when their values are: 1, 1.0 and 1e0 are equal. toString() returns the number as written.

Since:
0.1.0
